title: Partners
description: Find Hank, investigate Carlos Ortiz’s murder, explain the evidence, and locate the missing android.

source.commit: local source snapshot; pinned by sha256

assumptions: Optional scans retain source observation text. Silent clues use source flowchart labels and minimal authored descriptions.
Two reconstructions gate reporting to Hank: body evidence and the kitchen assault evidence. These are explicit adaptation gates, not recovered numeric game thresholds.
Three incorrect reconstruction answers end the investigation. Each wrong answer is recorded as an evidence error, not automatically classified as a deliberate lie.

WAIT deliberately advances to the source timeout scene. Spilling Hank’s drink causes refusal; otherwise one additional investigation period is granted. No wall-clock timeout is enforced because a defensible duration is not established by this corpus.
The attic discovery ends with Connor’s fixed canonical report to Hank. There is no fabricated option to conceal the suspect.
Relationship deltas are signed event counters, not the game’s hidden numeric relationship scale.
omissions: Magazine interactions and unused-content blocks are intentionally excluded.
Walking and motor gestures are represented by explicit navigation actions, not simulated controls.
Continuous scanning reticles and the exact forensic reconstruction animation controls are represented by inspect/reconstruct actions.
Unchosen timeout dialogue and unused reply variants are excluded. Incidental street crowd lines are not exhaustively reproduced.

bar-intro.text:
Connor: Lieutenant Anderson, my name is Connor. I’m the android sent by CyberLife.

Connor: I looked for you at the station but nobody knew where you were. They said you were probably having a drink nearby. I was lucky to find you at the fifth bar.

Hank: What do you want?

Connor: You were assigned a case early this evening. A homicide, involving a CyberLife android. In accordance with procedure, the company has allocated a specialized model to assist investigators.

Hank: Well, I don’t need any assistance. Specially not from a plastic asshole like you. So just be a good lil' robot and get the fuck outta here.

actions.label: REASON
actions.text: Connor: Listen, I think you should stop drinking and come with me. It'll make life easier for both of us.

actions.label: THREATEN
actions.text: Connor: Lieutenant Anderson, I must inform you that I intend to file a report on your behavior.

actions.label: UNDERSTANDING
actions.text:
Connor: I understand that some people are not comfortable in the presence of androids but I am-

Hank: I am perfectly comfortable… Now back off, before I crush you like an empty beer can!

actions.label: PERSIST
actions.text:
Connor: I'm sorry, Lieutenant, but I must insist. My instructions stipulate that I have to accompany you.

Hank: You know where you can stick your instructions?

Connor: No... where?

Hank: Never mind.

actions.label: SPILL HIS DRINK
actions.text:
Connor: I think we can go now.

Hank: You little prick! I don't know what's stopping me from knocking you out…

Connor: Your sense of duty, Lieutenant. And the cost of repairs if you damage me. For your information, I'm worth a small fortune.

Hank: Wonders of technology… They can even program assholes these days… Gotta go! Duty calls…

actions.label: BUY HIM ANOTHER DRINK
actions.text:
Connor: You know what? I'll buy you one for the road. What do you say? Bartender, the same again, please!

Hank: See that, Jim? Wonders of technology… Make it a double. Did you say homicide?

actions.label: WAIT OUTSIDE
actions.text:
Connor: I apologize, Lieutenant. I didn't mean to bother you. I'll wait for you outside. Take your time.

Hank: Did you say homicide?

car.text: Hank: You wait here. I won't be long.

actions.label: PATIENT
actions.text:
Connor: Whatever you say, Lieutenant.

Hank: Fucking-A, whatever I say…

actions.label: FIRM
actions.text:
Connor: No way! I'm coming with you.

Hank: Listen, you really have to stop pissing me off if you wanna make it through the rest of the night in one piece.

actions.label: DIPLOMATIC
actions.text:
Connor: My instructions are to accompany you to the crime scene, Lieutenant.

Hank: Listen, I don’t give a fuck about your instructions. I told you to wait here, so you shut the fuck up and you wait here.

follow.text:
Journalist: Joss Douglas, for Channel 16. Can you confirm that this is a homicide?

Hank: I'm not confirming anything.

order-reply.text:
Hank: What part of ‘stay in the car’ didn’t you understand?

Connor: Your order contradicted my instructions, Lieutenant.

briefing.text:
Hank: You don't talk, you don't touch anything and you stay outta my way, got it?

Connor: Got it,

Ben: Evening, Hank. We were starting to think you weren’t gonna show…

Hank: Yeah, that was the plan until this asshole found me.

Ben: So... you got yourself an android, huh?

Hank: Oh, very funny. Just tell me what happened.

Ben: We had a call around eight from the landlord. The tenant hadn't paid his rent for a few months, so he thought he'd drop by, see what was going on… That’s when he found the body… Jesus, that smell! Was even worse before we opened the windows… The victim’s name's Carlos Ortiz. He has a record for theft and aggravated assault... According to the neighbors, he was kind of a loner… Stayed inside most of the time, they hardly ever saw him.

Hank: Uh, state he’s in... Wasn’t worth calling everybody out in the middle of the night… Could've waited 'til morning.

Ben: I'd say he's been there for a good three weeks. We'll know more when the coroner gets here. There's a kitchen knife over here… Probably the murder weapon…

Hank: Any sign of a break-in?

Ben: Nope… The landlord said the front door was locked from the inside, all the windows were boarded up. The killer must've gone out the back way.

Hank: What do we know about his android?

Ben: Not much. The neighbors confirmed he had one, but it wasn't here when we arrived…

Ben: I gotta get some air. Make yourself at home. I'll be outside if you need me.

investigation.text: Carlos Ortiz’s body is in the living room. The kitchen, bathroom and back door can be examined.

actions.label: Report to Lieutenant Anderson
actions.text:
Connor: Lieutenant, I think I’ve figured out what happened.

Hank: Oh yeah? Shoot. I’m all ears.

actions.label: WAIT
actions.text: Connor waits as the investigation continues.

living-room.text: The victim, writing on the wall and traces of blood are visible. A kitchen knife lies nearby.

actions.label: Reconstruct
actions.text: The reconstruction shows the wounded victim fleeing the kitchen and collapsing in the living room after repeated knife wounds.

actions.label: Sample blood
actions.text:
Hank: Err, Jesus! What the hell are you doing?

Connor: I'm analyzing the blood. I can check samples in real time. I'm sorry, I should have warned you…

Hank: Ok, just… don't… put anymore evidence in your mouth, you got it?

Connor: Got it.

Hank: Fucking hell, I can't believe this shit…

DRIED BLOOD
DNA Analysis: ORTIZ, Carlos
Sample date: >19 days

actions.label: Investigate writing
actions.text:
The message on the wall reads “I AM ALIVE”.

Hank: Each letter is perfect… It’s way too neat, no human writes like this. Chris, was this written in the victim's blood?

Chris: I would say so… We’re taking samples for analysis.

actions.label: Analyze knife
actions.text: A bloodied kitchen knife lies near the victim.

actions.label: Examine Eden Club flyer
actions.text: An Eden Club flyer is among the victim’s possessions.

actions.label: Open closet
actions.text: The closet contains an android’s clothing.

body-info.text: Connor can examine the victim’s identity, injuries and fingerprints.

actions.label: INFORMATION
actions.text:
ORTIZ, CARLOS
Height: 5' 6'' - Weight: 286.6 lbs

28 KNIFE WOUNDS
Internal bleeding, 28 stab wounds
Deceased more than 19 days ago

FINGERPRINTS

Connor: He was stabbed 28 times.

Hank: Yeah, seems like the killer really had it in for him.

kitchen.text: A chair is overturned. A baseball bat and a knife rack are near signs of a struggle.

actions.label: Reconstruct
actions.text: The reconstruction shows Ortiz striking his android with the bat. The android takes the missing knife from the rack and strikes back.

actions.label: Examine chair

actions.label: Analyze baseball bat

actions.label: Analyze missing knife

RED ICE

Toluene, Hydrochloric acid

Hank: Red ice… Seems our friend Carlos liked to party… Chris, I want full analysis on the narcotics.

Chris: Consider it done, Lieutenant.

bathroom.text: The bathroom contains a closed shower curtain. Marks cover part of the wall.

actions.label: Check shower
actions.text: Connor draws back the shower curtain.

actions.label: Analyze blood on walls
actions.text: Repeated signs and marks cover the bathroom walls.

shower.text: Inside the shower are repeated “rA9” markings and a small statuette.

actions.label: Examine rA9 markings
actions.text: The same sign, “rA9”, is repeated over and over.

actions.label: Examine statuette
actions.text: Connor examines the small statuette.

backyard.text: There are shoe prints in the garden soil.

actions.label: INFORMATION
actions.text:
SHOE PRINT
Model K52 DPD - 10'
Less than 60 minutes ago

Hank: Door was locked from the inside. Killer must've gone out this way…

Connor: There are no footprints, apart from officer Collins' size 10 shoes.

Hank: Well, this happened weeks ago. Tracks could've faded.

Connor: No, this type of soil would've retained a trace. Nobody's been out here for a long time.

hank-leaving.text: Hank: All right… I’m outta here. Thanks for the ride. Great party.

actions.label: Ask for more time
actions.text:
Connor: Wait, Lieutenant! I can’t stay if you leave.

Hank: Much as it breaks my heart, this is where we part ways.

Connor: I just need five minutes to finish my investigation.

remember-drink.text: Connor: Please, Lieutenant. Remember the drink I bought you at the bar? Just five minutes.

time-granted.text:
Hank: Five minutes.

Connor: Thank you, Lieutenant.

Hank: Whatever!

time-refused.text: Hank: You spill a man’s drink, you piss him off all evening, and then you ask for a favor? Fuck you.

timed-out.text: Hank: Okay, time's up. I’m outta here. Have a nice evening, Sherlock. Don't let the door hit you on the way out.

reconstruct-2.text:
Hank: There're obvious signs of a struggle... The question is, what exactly happened here…

Connor: I think the victim attacked the android…

actions.label: …WITH THE BAT.
actions.text:
Connor: …With the bat.

Hank: That lines up with the evidence… Go on.

actions.label: …WITH THE KNIFE.

Hank: No, that can’t be right… It doesn’t fit the evidence.

actions.label: …WITHOUT A WEAPON.

actions.label: THE ANDROID STABBED THE VICTIM.
actions.text:

Hank: So the android was trying to defend itself, right?.. Okay, then what happened?

Connor: The victim fled to…

Hank: And he tried to get away from the android… All right, that makes sense…

reconstruct-5.text: Connor: The android murdered the victim…

actions.label: …WITH THE KNIFE
actions.text:
Connor: …with the knife.

Hank: Ok, your theory's not totally ridiculous… but it doesn’t tell us where the android went.

Connor: It was damaged by the bat… and lost some Thirium…

Hank: Lost some what?

Connor: Thirium. You call it “Blue Blood”. It’s the fluid that powers androids' biocomponents. It evaporates after a few hours and becomes invisible to the naked eye.

Hank: Oh… But I bet you can still see it, can't you?

Connor: Correct.

Hank: Yeah…

actions.text: The trail leads up to an attic hatch.

attic-access.text: The attic hatch is above Connor’s reach.

actions.label: Take a chair
actions.text:
Hank: Hey! Hey! Hey! What are you doin’ with that chair?

Connor: I’m going to check something.

Hank: Huh... gonna check something.

attic.text: Connor climbs into the dark attic.

found.text:
Deviant: I was just defending myself… He was gonna kill me.… I'm begging you… Don't tell them.

Hank: Connor, what the fuck is going on up there?

Connor: It's here, Lieutenant!

Hank: Holy shit… Chris, Ben, get your asses in here now. Come on!

unsolved.text: Connor leaves the crime scene with Hank. The android has not been found.

bad-reconstruction.text: Hank: Okay, I've just hit my bullshit quota for the evening. There’s a killer on the loose and I’m wasting my time listening to an android… I’m outta here.

cordon.text:
Police android: Androids are not permitted beyond this point.

Hank: It's with me.
